checks: Strict midpoint containment identifies the actual integer fibers and gives slack for all small independent middle affine motions. The compatible circuit fact puts the maximizing mark in the own interior and supplies finite actual attaining normals and a whole-plane cover. The endpoint groups isolate their triangles strictly and have masses at most the old common budget.

Fixing cap planes retains the three-plane cover under every small middle affine motion. A middle-area gain with no increase of its circuit caps would increase the normalization denominator while all actual marks remain covered below the old raw budget.

Checked the proper-chord derivative by pulling the cap back to the fixed triangle and slicing along its normal. The threshold change is uniformly O(t), and a proper chord has relative-interior points strictly inside the body, so dominated convergence handles a chord endpoint at a triangle vertex. The determinant yields the trace term.

The common inward dilation has cap derivatives -2C_j and each C_j is positive. It proves closedness of the finite conic span by bounding sums of coefficients. If separation gave weakly nonpositive cap responses and positive area response, a small multiple of this dilation makes all cap responses strictly negative while preserving objective gain.

Testing translations, the identity matrix, and arbitrary A gives the three displayed balances. The positive section lengths and minimal circuit force all multipliers positive. In the pair case chord lengths agree and the two areas sum to b. In the triple case the rank-two normals have one-dimensional dependence, so the chord centroid coordinates agree and their common point lies at the concurrent mark.

Checked f3e1e26ab17d09a3 proof §§1–3, particularly (2)–(3). The full-stress clause conditions on a stress that tests the independently varied affine directions, whose coverage terms and endpoint cap derivatives vanish on this test.

dependencies.hypotheses: The same-wave local strict triangle theorem gives global deepestness of the middle and its endpoint comparisons. These are exactly the local-minimum and strict containment assumptions here. Its approval is required before admission.

Apply the accepted ordinary compatible-fiber theorem at base one in planar dimension two. The positive maximizing mark is interior by its proof and the selected minimal circuit has two or three actual positive raw-mass caps.

overlap.comparison: The accepted objective-one joint stress for a fixed normal-fan bounded-facet chart gives section-base transport. It does not test all independent middle affine motions in the strict triangle class or conclude chord bisection.
The accepted weighted chord inequality assumes bisection of the tested chords. The current statement derives it at the local minimum.
The circuit fact gives actual active cap existence and coverage but no affine stationarity of the triangular fibers.

readability: The objective-one stress clause is conditional on the given stationarity identity. The elementary cone argument supplies the existence of the middle multipliers independently.

summary: An arbitrary selected minimal middle circuit has positive affine stationarity weights, and those weights force a common midpoint at the source for a triple.
